notes_list.title: Balz–Schiemann Fluorination
notes_list.basic_overview: Aryl diazonium tetrafluoroborate salts decompose on heating to produce aryl fluorides with loss of nitrogen and boron-containing products.
notes_list.extra_info_content:
Exam clue: ArN2+BF4− --heat→ ArF + N2 + BF3-related products. This is a classical method for replacing an aromatic diazonium group with fluorine.

MECHANISM & STEPWISE EXPLANATION
The aryl diazonium tetrafluoroborate thermally decomposes with loss of N2, giving an aryl fluoride.
